title: 20% off Storewide with 90 Day StoreCash Sign Up and Activation (Exclusions Apply) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: 20% off Storewide with 90 Day StoreCash Sign Up and Activation (Exclusions Apply) @ The Good Guys

[Nivlac] Yes, in fact you can stack 5 of em together.
Let me know how you go.
[PainToad] @ozbargainerlife1: Oh Trollback too. Forgot that one!
[timliu1996] You've been on OzBargain for almost a decade. Have you ever seen discount codes like this are stackable?
If it works, can I stack 10 codes? Not only would they give me the item for free, but they'd also have to pay me the price of the item!
[bluemyself] I was so excited until I realised it doesn't work on special orders…
Also I don't get what 90 Day StoreCash is. Is it a loyalty program or something?
[shxhshzhz] Yes. It gives rewards (store credit) from purchases.
E.g.
$100 StoreCash from buying this oven
[Harsh Deep] does that mean, we only get storecash on things, if it says on the item ( like your link) ?? or you get 20% as store cash on everything except excluded items ???
[shxhshzhz] 20% off in the deal is 20% off the price of items with a code given after signing up to StoreCash
StoreCash is store credit earned from purchases of items that have a StoreCash promotion
[ricee007] Re-signed up and got my 20% vouchee
Used 5% off corporate discount gift cards
Got 4% cashback
And the x60 ultra is $700 off.
Had a $50 corporate award points thingy, and i can tell myself the dreame x60 ultra only cost me $1,665 or so delivered, which is lower than its ever been.
[toyapple9] Mate, how did you get 4% cashback?..i thought it gets nullfied if you use discounted gift cards. Let me know pls
[toyapple9] Did the resignup, followed the steps and recieved 20% discount code via sms. Thanks op
[fruxo] Does it stack with the $30 off $150 voucher?
[nemesis123] Where can I find the PIN? I received a text with the 20% discount code, but I didn't get the PIN
[trishmapow] Doesn't need a PIN, it's a promo code you apply on checkout, not a gift card.
[TestIgnoreMe] Does this work in-store as well, where the salesperson can offer a lower price including delivery? I'm looking at buying a new fridge, and a salesperson quoted me $1,900 delivered, even though the retail price was $2k.
[clausman] Can you ask for price match first via online chat before using the 20%?
[Jvin] When I tried to apply the code to a price beaten item, I get the message "price beat has expired and so has been removed". Apparently price beat is considered as a discount code.
[nubzy] Doesn't work with the instant price beat. Wonder if it works with price beat in store or over live chat/phone?
[dRealSinghShady] Didn’t work this morning for me on live chat price beat. Either you checkout yourself with the 20% off code or they send you a price beat link.
Would also like to know if in store it works.
[Billybob94111] Anyone else stuck trying to activate it? Wont send me the text code. Been waiting 5+ minutes.
[bub] Don’t know if this is the issue you’re having too, but when I first made a GG account ages ago I turned off promotional sms and email in the GG account. I had to turn them back on to get the code after activating the storecash
[tiara] The code doesn't work for LG Fridge. But LG is not on the exclusion list
[archieduh] How is this deal not crazy upvoted? I don't remember a deal like this and I am trying to think of what I can buy as I don't have any need and wish I did.
$3 off coupon for $30 gift card deal today has 700+ upvotes and this crazy deal has less than 50 after 6 hours of posting. Am I missing something?
